responsibility: Implements the 64-bit-capable FreeBSD rs6000 subtarget configuration. It handles 32/64-bit mode selection, ABI and code-model validation, assembler and linker spec multiplexing, TOC/cmodel policy, default processor choices, type-layout differences, profiling/runtime conventions, and ELFv1/ELFv2 interactions, making it the main configuration header for biarch or 64-bit PowerPC FreeBSD targets.
